items.followUp: Name the vegetative and reproductive parts of a pea plant.

rubric.why: Roots, stems and leaves perform vegetative functions.
rubric.description: Names the vegetative parts of mustard.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the roots, stem and leaves.

rubric.why: Flowers, fruits and seeds are involved in reproduction.
rubric.description: Names the reproductive parts of mustard.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the flowers, fruits (pods) and seeds.

modelAnswer: The vegetative parts of mustard are the roots, stem and leaves.
The reproductive parts are the flowers, fruits (pods) and seeds.

items.followUp: State one difference between a colonial organism and a multicellular organism.

rubric.why: Colonial cells live together but retain considerable independence.
rubric.description: Describes the grouping and relative independence of cells in a colony.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that cells are grouped together and can function independently.

rubric.why: Multicellular organisms have specialized cells that depend on one another.
rubric.description: Describes specialization and interdependence in multicellular organisms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that their cells are specialized and interdependent.

modelAnswer: In a colonial organism, similar cells live together in a group, but each cell can generally perform its life functions independently.
In a multicellular organism, cells are specialized and interdependent, and may be organized into tissues and organs.
